name: Phat
summary: Four-player partnership trick-taking game descended from All Fours where teams score for valuable cards won and for majority of card-points.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships crosswise use a 52-card pack, 13 cards each. Rank is A K Q J 10 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 in all suits. Lowest cut pitches first; dealer is to pitcher's right, play and deal rotate left. Pitcher leads first trick; its suit is trump for the hand. Must follow suit if possible, otherwise any card. Highest card of led suit wins unless a trump is played, then highest trump wins. Winner leads next. During play partnerships immediately peg phat points for specific valuable cards captured in tricks. After all tricks, each side totals game points from counting cards captured: side with more than half pegs 8 muck points. 88 points per deal, game to 181 points on a 90-hole cribbage-style board.
rating_reason: Partnership trick-taking, All Fours family, strategic.
